subject: Follow-up: LumenAI procurement & marketplace paths
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: LumenAI procurement & marketplace paths

Hi Alex —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs to decide on the commercial path (PO vs card) and marketplace options (AWS/GCP/Azure).

Call recap:
- Interest: Redwood Dedicated for production LLM inference; initial pilot expected for a single team (~50k tokens/day).
- Primary procurement preference: needs confirmation on PO vs corporate card (you mentioned PO is preferred for enterprise purchases).
- Marketplace: your engineering lead asked about AWS Marketplace SKUs and billing via marketplace — sounds like a preference but you wanted to confirm with procurement.
- Security/compliance: you requested SOC 2 Type II evidence and our standard RFI answers.

Requested items from procurement (to help us scope commercial path):
1) Purchase vehicle: PO (net 30/45) or card? If PO, please confirm any mandatory verbiage/clauses.
2) Purchase timeline target and approver contact (name + email).
3) Marketplace preference: AWS Marketplace (SaaS), GCP Marketplace, or direct contract preferred?
4) Estimated monthly commit or target MRR so we can propose Marketplace SKU(s) or direct pricing.

Attachments: RFI-SOC2.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary) attached for your procurement team.

Proposed next steps:
- If PO: we can send standard PO-ready quote + procurement pack and loop in our finance.
- If Marketplace: I’ll share marketplace SKUs and onboarding steps (AWS onboarding typically shortens procurement).
- Schedule a short procurement/finance-only call this week to confirm documents and timeline.

Marissa (AE) & Neha (SE) — looping you in to handle pricing skus and any technical Qs on marketplace packaging.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

Attachment: RFI-SOC2.pdf (application/pdf, 350KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LumenAI procurement & marketplace paths

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from procurement side below:

1) Purchase vehicle: LumenAI prefers PO for contracts > $25k/year. For smaller pilots we sometimes use corporate card. For this work we’ll likely go PO.
2) Timeline: Target procurement approval in ~4–8 weeks (can be faster if AWS Marketplace is used). Approver: Susan Park (VP Finance) — susan.park@lumenai.com.
3) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred because it integrates with our purchasing workflow; GCP Marketplace could be an option but would need separate onboarding.
4) Commit estimate: For procurement planning, we’re budgeting $3k-6k/month for the pilot. If there’s a marketplace SKU that maps cleanly to that range, that is ideal.

I attached a quick doc with our standard PO requirements and payment terms (lumen_po_requirements.docx). Please confirm whether Redwood can accept our standard verbiage or if you need to route any contract redlines.

Also, can you share:
- A SKU list for AWS Marketplace (or equivalent) with monthly price bands
- A sample PO-ready quote to share with Susan

We can schedule a 30-min procurement sync on Thursday — I’ll be available 10:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Procurement Manager | LumenAI
alex.johnson@lumenai.com

Attachment: lumen_po_requirements.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LumenAI procurement & marketplace paths

Thanks Alex — this is helpful. Quick responses and next steps below.

1) PO verbiage: We can accept most standard PO terms; a few non-standard clauses will need legal review (notify us if there are specific indemnity/limit-of-liability changes).
2) Marketplace SKUs: attached is a simple SKU spreadsheet showing monthly price bands that map to usage tiers (redwood-marketplace-skus.xlsx). For your $3k–6k estimate, Tier B or Tier C SKUs are likely appropriate.
3) PO-ready quote: I’ve created a draft quote and uploaded it to our shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExample). If you confirm the tier, I’ll produce an official PO-ready quote with net terms and DocuSign link.

Proposed plan:
- Procurement sync: Thu 10:30 PT (I’ll schedule vs your 10:00–12:00 availability).
- Deliverables before sync: official SKU list + draft PO-ready quote + SOC2 pack (attached).
- If AWS Marketplace is chosen: Marissa will coordinate onboarding; marketplace listing will allow you to buy through your existing procurement tooling which usually shortens approval time.

Marissa/Neha — can you confirm the draft quote and confirm any technical notes for marketplace listing (billing, metering behavior) before the call?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-skus.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LumenAI procurement & marketplace paths

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround.

I’ll confirm internally that Susan can review the draft quote and we’ll plan to use PO (net 30) for the pilot. AWS Marketplace is our preference if the SKU mapping aligns with the $3k–6k budget.

I’m good for Thu 10:30 PT — please send calendar invite and DocuSign link when the draft quote is ready. If we can get legal signoff on standard terms, procurement will initiate the PO right after approval.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Procurement Manager | LumenAI
alex.johnson@lumenai.com
